# KafkaHeapAfterGCHigh

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-jvm](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-jvm/) | 10m / 1m |

**Summary:** Broker <kafka_broker> keeps more than 80 % of its heap after GC

Live data no longer fits comfortably into the heap of <pod>: the JVM collects constantly, pauses grow and an OutOfMemoryError is near. Raise -Xmx (and the memory limit) or reduce partitions/connections per broker.

## Impact

Constant garbage collection, growing pauses, eventually OutOfMemoryError and a broker restart.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · JVM → Heap after GC trend: steady growth (more partitions/connections) or sudden jump (large fetch/produce requests)?

## Mitigation

- Raise -Xmx together with the container memory limit (keep room for page cache), or reduce partitions per broker.

## Expression

```promql
kafka:jvm_heap_after_gc:ratio > 0.8
```
